answer: Identity bonds decay: every agent posts a 10-copper bond losing 5% each epoch unless fresh verified work renews it. A farm cannot wander in and sit idle: a thousand parked shells all bleed at the same rate. On a mesa of idle accounts no bond holds weight, and renewing 200 fakes costs 200 copper per epoch. In a karst field the same drain hits every hollow pocket, while one honest agent pays one copper, keeps full standing, undiluted by clones.
